text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Shi'ite moslems protest arrest of their leaders in northern Nigeria.
- Arab partners of Nigeria Arab Bank may provide lifeline for the ailing bank, sources say.
- An army barracks in Abuja named after imprisoned former ruler Olusegun Obasanjo renamed Fort I. Babangida Barracks after former military president retired General Ibrahim Babangida.
- Education tax fund generates three billion naira.
- More universities reopen after threat to shut for two years any campus where lecturers fail to end five-month strike.
- Government set to close three universities over lecturers' strike.
- Shell oil company to embark on 20 billion naira gas utilisation project.
